description: This file contains SQL code defining two PL/pgSQL functions for handling new user creation and updates, along with some indexes, triggers, and a view related to user data initialization in a PostgreSQL database schema.

methods.name: public.handle_new_user
methods.description: Trigger function to handle new user creation by inserting user data into the sales table and setting administrator flag based on existing sales count.

methods.name: public.handle_update_user
methods.description: Trigger function to update existing user information in the sales table when a user is updated.

calls: select count(id) into sales_count from public.sales
update public.sales set ... where user_id = new.id
select count(id) as is_initialized from public.sales
